name: AI Innovation Club
description: A student group passionate about machine learning, generative AI, and cutting-edge tech. We organize weekly hackathons, reading groups, and guest speaker sessions from top tech companies.

name: Language Exchange Café
description: Weekly casual meetups at local cafés to practice languages. Perfect for international students wanting to learn German and local students wanting to practice other languages.

name: Campus Football (Soccer) League
description: Casual, mixed-gender football matches twice a week. We play on the university sports fields. All skill levels are welcome. Post-game drinks/socials are a regular event!

name: Weekly Board Game Night
description: A cozy gathering for fans of modern board games, from Catan to complex strategy games. We meet every Friday evening, bring snacks, and play in a relaxed atmosphere.

name: Alpine Hiking & Outdoor Club
description: We organize weekend hiking trips to local trails and the Alps. Enjoy beautiful landscapes, clean air, and great conversations while climbing mountains.

name: Erasmus & International Meetup
description: The ultimate social club for Erasmus and international students. We host city tours, pub crawls, and cultural evenings to help you integrate quickly and make friends.

name: Student Startup Incubator Network
description: A community for aspiring entrepreneurs, designers, and developers. Meet co-founders, pitch ideas, attend pitch nights, and learn about the local startup ecosystem.

name: Global Cooking & Foodies Club
description: Every week, a different member hosts a cooking workshop showing how to make traditional dishes from their home country. A tasty way to discover new cultures!

name: International Coffee Chit-Chat
description: A relaxed morning meet-up where students get together, grab a cup of coffee or tea, and talk about everything and nothing. Super easy-going and welcoming.

name: Campus Beach Volleyball Club
description: Whether you're a beginner or an advanced player, join us on the sand courts for beach volleyball, music, and sun. We play all summer and move indoors in winter.

name: Creative Writing & Book Club
description: For readers and writers alike. We discuss a book of the month and share our own poems, short stories, and essays. Perfect for a cozy evening of intellectual exchange.

name: Esports & Gaming League
description: Our league hosts local and online tournaments for popular games like League of Legends, Valorant, Super Smash Bros, and Rocket League. We also stream our games on Twitch.

name: Eco-Students Volunteering Initiative
description: Join our local environmental volunteering program. We organize trash collection walks, tree planting sessions, and sustainability workshops around the city.

name: Campus Jam Session Circle
description: A group for musicians of all instruments and levels. We rent a rehearsal room weekly to jam, cover favorite songs, and occasionally prepare for campus open mic nights.

name: Maker Space & Robotics Lab
description: A hands-on engineering club where we build robots, work with 3D printers, and code microcontrollers. Get help with your university projects or build your own ideas.

name: German Conversation Stammtisch
description: The classic German pub gathering. Practice your conversational German in a cozy local beer garden or tavern. Open to all learning levels, from A1 to C2.

name: Early Bird Running Group
description: Start your day with energy! We meet at 7:00 AM on weekdays for a 5K or 8K run through the city park, followed by a quick breakfast together before lectures start.

name: Bakers & Pastry Makers Circle
description: Do you love baking cookies, sourdough bread, or french pastries? Join us in our baking session where we share recipes, tips, and of course, eat delicious pastries.

name: Social Impact Hub
description: We design social entrepreneurship projects to help refugees, senior citizens, and homeless people in our city. If you want to use your student skills for good, join us!

name: Anime, Manga & Asian Culture Guild
description: A fun, enthusiastic community centered around anime, manga, webtoons, and Asian pop culture. We host watch parties, manga discussions, and trip groups to local conventions.
